summary: Malta's LULUCF entry is a 2030 net-removals value of -2 Kt CO2eq. The document gives an EU-wide 310 Mt CO2-eq net-removals target for 2030; the FF55 passage expresses the same commitment as -310 Mt CO2-eq and an additional 42 Mt CO2-eq relative to the 2016-2018 average. These LULUCF figures are emissions/removals commitments, not area targets; the 2022 land-cover context does not report forest, grassland or wetland extent. Restoration is EU-level: at least 20% of EU land and 20% of EU sea areas by 2030, not a stated 20% share of Malta's 316 km². Agricultural measures are financial: 40% of CAP allocations in 2023-2027, at least 25% of annual direct-payment funds for eco-schemes, and 35% of Pillar II funds for environmental and climate activities. The supplied land-cover context records 177 km² of agriculture (55.9%), but no hectare coverage is specified.
